slides.say: Amazon's Alexa now shops for millions of people. Your store could lose sales.
Amazon just said shoppers can now text Alexa to help them shop. It rolls out to millions of users in the coming weeks.
That means a customer asks the AI, and the AI picks the product. They never open Google. They never see your website.
If an AI assistant can't read your prices, your reviews and your stock, it won't recommend you.
So this week, put your prices, your reviews and your FAQs on your website in plain text. Not hidden in images.
Follow for one AI move for your business, every day.

caption:
AI assistants are starting to choose what people buy. If they can't read your business, you're invisible.

Amazon now lets shoppers text Alexa to help them shop, rolling out to millions in the coming weeks.

The fix is boring and free: prices, reviews and FAQs on your site as real text.
